ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation is concentrated in large contiguous blobs at the distal tips of both lobes; the central and medial regions are dominated by low-intensity black pixels with sparse, localized white mottling/speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A narrow V-shaped central notch is visible with an estimated vertex angle of 40 degrees; the lower vertex point is partially obscured by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2 to 6 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a distinct concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels are visible on the medial-posterior region of the right lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct vertical linear pixel disruption (rake mark) is visible on the inner-medial surface of the left lobe, breaking the dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tips of both fluke lobes show significant irregular edge loss; the right tip displays a distinct cluster of brownish-orange pixels (hex range #8B4513 to #A52A2A) suggesting biological growth or exposed tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-orange discoloration present at the extreme lateral points of both fluke lobes, contrasting with the primary black and white fluke pigmentation.
